decision_semantics.description: The rights-agent verifies and binds existing human-reviewed approved_source and approved_source_rights_scopes evidence. It does not create, replace, or infer a human rights decision.

required_evidence: source license reviewer identity and timestamp
rights-scope reviewer identity and timestamp matching the source license review
authority_invariants: No new human rights decision is synthesized.
No technical or instructional review is created.
No public scenario question is created.
No assessment eligibility, scoring, delivery, API, or release authority is created.
Promotion into scenario_questions remains a later explicit governed phase.

recovery.ledger_missing_after_validation: safe; rerun revalidates current rights evidence and appends the transition
